name: Oracle's Forge
description: 🔮 Forge Prophecy Crystals (ML models) in the Sacred Fire. Prepare the auspices, ignite AutoML, battle models in the Arena, crown a champion in the Model Registry, and read the Prophecy with batch scoring. A full Data Science quest on real Fabric.
learning_objectives: Prepare and explore a dataset in a Fabric Lakehouse with Spark + pandas
Run Fabric AutoML (FLAML) to search models automatically
Track experiments, parameters and metrics with MLflow
Compare candidate models and select a champion by metric
Register the champion model in the MLflow model registry
Score new data in batch with the Fabric PREDICT function
Validate that the final model beats the target metric threshold

items.name: OraclesForge_LH
items.description: Holds omens_train (input), omens_holdout (oracle), and prophecy_scores (player output) tables

items.name: OraclesForge_EH
items.description: Telemetry for level completions, model runs, best metrics and final rank

items.name: OraclesForge_Seed
items.description: Generates the synthetic omens_train + omens_holdout datasets (customer-churn style)

items.name: OraclesForge_Forge
items.description: Player workbench for Levels 1-4: EDA, AutoML, MLflow tracking, model comparison and registration

items.name: OraclesForge_Prophecy
items.description: Level 5: batch scoring with PREDICT and writing prophecy_scores

items.name: OraclesForge_Dashboard
items.description: KQL/Plotly dashboard: best metric over time, models tried, final rank

eventTypes.name: OracleCrowned
eventTypes.description: Champion model beats the threshold — quest complete

levels.name: Crown the Crystal
levels.skill: Register champion in the model registry

levels.name: The Prophecy
levels.skill: Batch scoring with PREDICT above threshold

post_deploy_steps: Run OraclesForge_Seed notebook once to populate omens_train + omens_holdout tables
Open OraclesForge_Judge notebook and read the Level 1 briefing
Work through Levels 1-4 in OraclesForge_Forge, running judge.check_level(N) after each
Run OraclesForge_Prophecy to score the holdout omens and write prophecy_scores
Run judge.check_level(5) to see if your Oracle beats the threshold
Watch OraclesForge_Dashboard track your best metric and final rank
